## Symptoms
The consumer logs a KeyError for a required field, or a JSON decode error. The rejected messages share the same shape.

## Likely causes
1. The producer changed the message shape without the consumer being updated.
2. The producer is publishing truncated payloads.

## How to confirm
Read a rejected message body. A renamed field points to a schema change; cut-off text points to a serialization problem. Compare with the order message contract.

## Fix options
Revert the producer change or update the consumer to accept both shapes. Replay rejected orders after approval.

## Escalate when
Messages from before and after the change are mixed in the queue.
